hypothesis: A mixture likelihood over entire masked TRAIN observation-incidence patterns can specialize tied shared-factor NCNC completion scorers coherently, yielding useful own-completion predictions beyond equally supervised member-mean marginal likelihood training.
target_random_variable: Z_er = counterpart edge observed in complete TRAIN snapshot, not latent true missing-link incidence C_er
unknown_link_semantics: Z=0 is known absence of TRAIN observation, not verified C=0. Dense source-absence reconstruction is an explicit denoising proxy beyond the native sampled-negative main loss.

label_contract.entry: source-positive counterpart missing after native record mask/coalescing

label_contract.auxiliary: Z=0 for observation-incidence reconstruction only; latent missing-link state remains unknown

label_contract.main: native y=0 training convention; not verified true nonlink

q_definition: q_mer = w_mer/alpha = sigmoid(2.5*(s_mer-6)+log(.1)); alpha remains1.05 in target feature weights

primary_pair.J: Native F4-private main objective + positive/negative query means of -(1/R_e)*logmeanexp_m(sum_r logBern(Z_er;q_mer))
primary_pair.F: Same main objective/labels/work + positive/negative query means of -(1/R_e)*sum_r logmeanexp_m(logBern(Z_er;q_mer))
primary_pair.empty_residual_rule: auxiliary zero, query retained in all-query mean
primary_pair.paired_initialization: fresh identical model/empty Adam/RNG; existing dedicated sign law at base seed0; no scientific donor from running/resource/engineering state
primary_pair.private_vs_pooled_scientific_switch: neither arm pools; both own/private completion; only reconstruction likelihood grouping differs

responsibility_gradient: rho_me=softmax_m(sum_r logBern(Z_er;q_mer)); dL_J(e)/dt_mer=rho_me*(q_mer-Z_er)/R_e. Shared maps/encoder sum these branch contributions. Main target loss still supervises all members.
inference: unchanged own native soft completion weights, private feature/decoder paths, equal mean raw logits; no Z-dependent training responsibilities or graph sampling at inference
selector: complete official VALID strict shared-pool Hits50; TRAIN-only graph; epochs1..100; first exact ties
diagnostics: paired served complete Hits50 and selected epochs
